data.name: Chidananda
data.gender_notes: Chidananda is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Chidananda is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Chid' meaning consciousness or self and 'Ananda' meaning bliss. This name signifies the attainment of supreme bliss through the realization of the true self. The name Chidananda carries the meaning “Supreme Bliss” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chidananda usually hope their child will grow to embody supreme bliss and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Seeking and experiencing supreme joy and self-realization.
data.etymology: Chidananda belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supreme Bliss.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chidananda total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
